query:
SELECT ph.id, ph.cardId, ph.grade, ph.price, ph.jpyPrice, ph.soldAt
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.nameJp LIKE '%サトシのピカチュウ%'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
ORDER BY ph.soldAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
